capabilities: Render a monthly habit calendar inside a dataviewjs code block
Populate the calendar from a Dataview table or manual data entries
Link and hover calendar days to daily notes or custom notes
Render cell content as HTML or Markdown
Customize habit labels and daily note date patterns
extras: A Chinese-language README is available separately; the author links an example vault showing the recommended habit-recording workflow. The README warns that Markdown rendered in calendar cells may display incorrectly until you switch files and switch back, and that HTML cell content must be enabled in the plugin settings.
intentEvidence: It's based on the Habit Track plugin by @duoani.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize habit completion across a month's daily notes inside a note.

relations.evidence: It's based on the Habit Track plugin by @duoani.
This plugin is intended to be used alongside DataviewJS.

summary: Renders a monthly habit calendar inside a DataviewJS code block, populated from a Dataview table or manually collected data.
